properties.name: raf.jackson.date-format
properties.description: Default date format pattern for java.util.Date serialization.

properties.name: raf.jackson.write-dates-as-timestamps
properties.description: Whether to serialize dates as Unix timestamps. When false, dates are serialized as formatted strings.

properties.name: raf.jackson.serialization-inclusion
properties.description: Controls which properties are included during serialization.

properties.name: raf.jackson.fail-on-unknown-properties
properties.description: Whether to fail when encountering unknown properties during deserialization. Set to false for forward compatibility.

properties.name: raf.jackson.fail-on-empty-beans
properties.description: Whether to fail when serializing a bean with no properties.

properties.name: raf.snow-flake.enabled
properties.description: Whether to enable the Snowflake distributed ID generator.

properties.name: raf.snow-flake.worker-id
properties.description: Worker node ID (0-31). Must be unique across all instances in the same datacenter.

properties.name: raf.snow-flake.data-center-id
properties.description: Datacenter ID (0-31). Must be unique across datacenters.

values.description: All properties are included regardless of value.
Only non-null and non-absent (Optional) properties are included.
Only non-null, non-absent, and non-empty properties are included.
